name: Hostel
concept: The Saint-Philippe hostel, 1989: the three-storey town house House_Town_E_2I02 (block b14, about 248 m2) fitted whole as a cheap place to sleep for a newcomer with no house yet. The ground floor's east half is the reception and common room (front) and the kitchen (back) with the washroom beside it; the west half, a workshop in the base game, becomes the luggage hall. The first floor holds the two dormitories, a washroom and a small kitchen. The attic is shut. This card is the shell: the vanilla set flattened and cut (switches, workshop clutter, attic junk, repeats); bunks, the reception desk and lockers come in pass 1. Base-game props only.

host.note: Placed in Saint-Philippe later by town fit (the town-draft card), indestructible through the place layer (D15). Until then it stands in the pack grid, claim hostel.

rooms.use: reception and common room: sofa, TV, desk (the reception desk in pass 1)
the guests' kitchen: stove, sink unit, table and corner bench
luggage hall (the base game's workshop, cleared); lockers in pass 1

fitout.note: the reception counter, bunks and lockers are plain furniture; the washrooms and kitchen come with the shell; the attic (floor 2) stays shut

looks.about: proof.json holds the shots as look/from pairs in building space; tools\cli look grid:hostel shoots the exterior and --interior x,y,z (world space: the building's grid position plus these) each room
